name: Door Cover
description:
FEATURES

  • Best material: The door cover is made are made of the highest quality athletic fabrics, weather-resistant, washable, reusable and simple to put on and take off. Water & UV resistant material extends the life of this cover and helps maintain its bright colors. Quality craftsmanship goes into every cover which has double sewn edges to prevent fraying.
  • Fabric: 100% Polyester
  • GSM: Approximately 140g/m2
  • Widely Usage: They come pre-assembled and ready to use indoor/outdoor. Depend on your purposes that you can apply it to wall or door as decoration sign. It can be a welcome banner in front of your doors or decoration in your living room/ garden/ party entrance gate.
  • Customization: We make porch banner on demand, so give us your design to create your one-of-a-kind porch banner. Creative 3D print will make your banner more gorgeous and vivid, creating typical atmosphere for your events.  
  • Easy Installation: Just hang the door cover on doors, windows, ceilings, walls, chalkboard, stand, fence and more, easy to make a wonderful decoration. Hang it up through the 4 grommet holes in the corner or use tapes. Our fabric door covers take less than a minute to install.
  • Gift of Love: A meaningful gift for your friends, family members, wife/husband, bridesmaid/groomsmen, coworkers, neighbors on birthday, Mother's day, Father’s Day, wedding, anniversary, graduation day, Christmas, engagement, Thanksgiving day, Valentine's day. A wonderful way to honor the memory of a special person or milestone.
  • Garment Care: Hand wash in cold water (below 30 degrees), no bleach, hang dry.


SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Door Cover

 

NOTE:

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

Download templates and mockups here

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
